tips_en: Read Jeveration first: its unified parallel-decision formulation and reported 122× generation speedup are highly provocative, while its generation–perception duality provides a useful multimodal baseline. Game2Player is the strongest follow-up for scalable agent learning, integrating environment construction, verification, and trajectory generation into a co-development loop. The surgical-adaptation paper is more specialized but complements both: they center on Qwen3.5 models, and its curvature-projected LoRA and dense updates could help preserve capabilities when fine-tuning or selectively unlearning such agents.
tips_zh: 建议优先阅读 Jeveration：其统一的并行决策框架和显著的生成加速最具启发性，并通过“生成—感知”双用途设计建立了有价值的多模态基线。若关注可扩展的智能体学习，第二篇 Game2Player 最值得跟进，它将环境构建、验证与轨迹生成整合为共同开发闭环。第三篇更专门，但与前两篇互补：前两篇均以 Qwen3.5 系列模型为核心，而其基于曲率投影的 LoRA 和稠密更新有望在微调或选择性遗忘智能体时减少能力退化。
